text:
Site 8 ruo 29 June 1958, Sweden ghọrọ mba Nordic na Scandinavian mbụ nke nabatara World Cup, na-anabata otu iri na isii n’oge amateur, tupu oge telivishọn nke football Europe nke ngwụcha 1950s. The finals gbasara n’obodo iri na abụọ nke Sweden, na-adọta ngụkọta ndị bịara 819,810 n’ofe egwuregwu 35, nkezi nke ihe dịka 23,400 kwa egwuregwu. Usoro ahụ malitere site na otu anọ nke anọ, nke ọ bụla bụ otu round-robin na-enye isi abụọ maka mmeri na otu maka draw, ya na playoffs iji dozie nha maka iru eru, tupu quarter-finals nke otu-elimination, semi-finals, egwuregwu ebe nke atọ na final.

The tournament mere ka Wales, Northern Ireland na Soviet Union pụta mbụ, ma wepụta draw mbụ na-enweghi goolu n’akụkọ World Cup. Akụkọ kachasị mkpa bụ mpụta nke Pele dị afọ 17, onye mere onwe ya ka kpakpando zuru ụwa wee bụrụ onye nta nke kacha nta gbaa goolu ma merie final World Cup. Just Fontaine nke France, n’aka nke ọzọ, gbara goolu 13 n’ofe mbipụta ahụ, ndekọ otu-tournament nke ka dị; ọ mechara ya site na goolu anọ na mmeri 6-3 nke France meriri West Germany n’egwuregwu ebe nke atọ na Gothenburg, na-enweta ebe nke atọ maka ndị otu ya.

The final, nke e mere na Rasunda Stadium na Solna n’ime Stockholm, tinyere Brazil megide ndị nnabata. Sweden gbara mbụ site n’aka Nils Liedholm, mana Brazil zaghachiri ka ha duru 2-1 na ọkara oge wee pụọ merie 5-2 na-enweghi oge mgbakwunye. Vava na Pele gbara goolu abụọ abụọ ebe Mario Zagalo tinye nke ise, Agne Simonsson wee gbaa nke abụọ nke Sweden. Nsonaazụ ahụ nyere Brazil aha World Cup mbụ ha, Sweden bụ ndị nke abụọ, ma mee Brazil otu otu na-abụghị Europe nke meriri World Cup e mere na Europe.
